query: What entity is responsible for administering the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015?
reference_answer: The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.
context:
[Document 1]
The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.

[Document 2]
A summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme can be found in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet.

[Document 3]
The information in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet is correct as of 1 April 2025.

[Document 4]
The CPF Board may impose and vary the terms and conditions of the MediShield Life scheme as provided for in the legislation.

[Document 5]
Dental work is covered under the MediShield Life Scheme only if required due to accidental injuries.
answer: The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015 [Document 1].
